entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I'm calling about an order. I think I need to return something. I'm just a bit lost on how to do it.
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number, please?
Sure. The name is Maria Valenti, and the order number is... VF7781-PULSE.
Thank you, Maria. I see the order here for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. Let me just confirm, you have the item with you, correct?
Yes, yes, it's right here. It's just... I don't think it's for me.
I understand. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, I don't think it's broken. It's just... it's all very overwhelming. The app, the settings... I thought it would be simpler. The website made it seem so easy. Can't you just help me? I just want to send it back.
Of course, I'm here to help. Let me check the delivery date. I see it was delivered to you on December 21st, so you've had it for about 25 days. One moment while I review our return policy.
Okay... I was worried it might be too late. I just got so flustered I didn't call right away.

No problem at all. I've just pulled up our policy, and it states that items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. So, at 25 days, you are unfortunately outside the window for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so sure I had missed my chance. Thank you!

It's my pleasure to clarify that for you. I can process this return for you right now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label. And since I see you're a VIP member with us, I'll go ahead and make that an expedited return label at no extra cost, so it gets back to us quickly.
That's wonderful! You've been so helpful, David. I was really stressed about this whole thing.

Happy to help, Maria. The email with the label is on its way to you now. Just pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you so much again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
